reason: ReDoS from a glob pattern with single-branch repeated extglobs; affects every picomatch release (<=4.0.7, the latest), no fix as of 2026-11-17. Only a malicious pattern triggers it, and none reaches picomatch here. In production it is reached only through @daytona/sdk -> fast-glob -> micromatch, which the SDK calls only in Image.fromDockerfile to expand a local Dockerfile's COPY sources; tavya never builds a Daytona image from a Dockerfile (src/world/environment-build.ts uses Image.base().runCommands() only). The other paths (vitest, vite, tinyglobby, fdir) are devDependencies, left out of the image by npm ci --omit=dev in deploy/Dockerfile, and match only the repository's own test globs.
